behaviors.description: Preserve permission enumeration contracts with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private permission store with independently seeded entries.
behaviors.expected: Exact table, object and app-filtered rows remain correct. No option-specific diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve per-app permission queries with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private permission store with independent subject and control apps.
behaviors.expected: Subject, control and absent-app results satisfy the original exact-row assertions. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve permission data mutation and rejection with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private permission store and independent D-Bus observers.
behaviors.expected: Typed data and permissions update exactly, omitted data is preserved, and malformed data fails without mutation. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve selected permission removal with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private permission store with subject and control grants.
behaviors.expected: Only the selected grant disappears and other entries remain intact. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve app permission reset with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Real private permission store with independently seeded subject and control entries.
behaviors.expected: Subject grants disappear across tables while control grants remain. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve real document read/write grants with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Private document portal, FUSE, installed independent app and controlled host file.
behaviors.expected: Sandbox writes change the origin only while granted; revocation preserves reads and blocks writes. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve document app filtering with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal and independently exported subject/control documents.
behaviors.expected: Exact document ID sets remain correct for all, subject, control and absent apps. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve document identity and grant queries with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal with controlled permission changes.
behaviors.expected: Queries by origin and exported path report exact identity and current permissions. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve real document revocation with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Private real portal, independent app, subject document and control export.
behaviors.expected: Revocation removes sandbox access and the export while retaining the origin and control grant. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve running-instance enumeration with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent live holding app with known launcher PID and environment.
behaviors.expected: Enumeration identifies the live process and loses it after public kill. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve entering a running sandbox with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent live parent and child apps with controlled environment markers.
behaviors.expected: Entered probes observe the exact child marker only when its PID is exposed to the parent. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve instance termination with both diagnostic flags.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent live holding app verified by public enumeration.
behaviors.expected: Public kill stops the selected process and removes its instance row. No diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve installed commit queries with verbose enabled throughout a real lifecycle.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent A/B app commits and runnable payloads.
behaviors.expected: Installed ref and commit queries follow the actual install/update/remove lifecycle. No verbose diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve public repository inspection with verbose enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repository with known refs, commits and metadata.
behaviors.expected: Repository branches, metadata and commit queries satisfy the independent assertions. No verbose diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve build initialization metadata with verbose enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent installed SDK/runtime and controlled tags and extension metadata.
behaviors.expected: Runtime, SDK, tags and extension directory retain their exact expected values. No verbose diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve bundle payload and origin contracts with verbose enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent repository, exact app commit and controlled origin URL.
behaviors.expected: The generated bundle installs the known commit and retains the supplied update origin. No verbose diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve commit signing with verbose enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent app commit and disposable signing material.
behaviors.expected: Signing preserves the commit checksum and passes independent public-key verification. No verbose diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Preserve build finalization metadata with OSTree verbosity enabled.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent unfinalized app with controlled metadata additions and removals.
behaviors.expected: Finalized command, runtime, SDK and extension metadata satisfy the original exact assertions. No OSTree diagnostic effect is claimed.

behaviors.description: Exercise explicit allow-read as the default-equivalent document grant.
behaviors.preconditions: Private portal, FUSE, independent app and host file outside sandbox access.
behaviors.expected: The explicit grant permits the exact document bytes, denies writes and preserves the host origin. This flag selects the default and has no separate effect credit.
